## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers to turn resource context into an explicit Sling Model view contract, extend Core Components through delegation, and recognize when Model Exporter already supplies the required JSON representation.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 17 follows the Java, OSGi and Resource API foundations from Class 16. It teaches how Sling Models adapt AEM context, receive values from explicit injectors, prepare a small view contract for HTL, delegate public Core Component behavior and optionally expose an eligible contract through Model Exporter.",
    "core_claim": "A useful Sling Model makes its runtime inputs and optionality explicit, prepares a small stable view contract, delegates behavior it does not own and exposes JSON only when an exporter contract already exists.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "A Sling Model is created by adapting supported Sling context through the Models Adapter Factory.",
      "Prefer a Resource adaptable when the model only needs resource content; use a request adaptable only for request-specific context.",
      "Sling Model packages must be registered in bundle metadata for runtime discovery.",
      "Injection is required by default unless optionality is explicitly declared.",
      "Injector-specific annotations communicate the source better than generic @Inject.",
      "Optional<T> is appropriate when absence is a legitimate part of the model contract.",
      "Fallback precedence, normalization and derived values belong in the model rather than HTL.",
      "HTL owns semantic markup and conditional rendering; the model owns prepared values and explicit state.",
      "Core Component implementations are private and should be extended through delegation against public model contracts.",
      "@Self with @Via(type = ResourceSuperType.class) obtains delegated behavior through the resource supertype.",
      "Reusable queries, integrations and orchestration belong in an OSGi service; a model may inject such a service with @OSGiService.",
      "An exporter-enabled model can be resolved by resource type and serialized for a .model.json request.",
      "Not every Sling Model automatically exposes .model.json."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Sling Model",
      "Models Adapter Factory",
      "Resource",
      "request adaptable",
      "@Model",
      "@ValueMapValue",
      "@ChildResource",
      "@OSGiService",
      "@Self",
      "@ScriptVariable",
      "Optional<T>",
      "HTL",
      "sling:resourceSuperType",
      "ResourceSuperType.class",
      "Model Exporter",
      ".model.json",
      "Jackson"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Use the exact title and metadata. Show one compact Guide Card resource entering a central Sling Model contract, then branching to HTL-rendered HTML and an explicitly conditional JSON representation. The JSON branch must say ELIGIBLE EXPORTER only."
  }
}
